transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to discuss Mr. Lewis's potential enrollment in our remote-monitoring program after his discharge for heart-failure care. As we all know, our standard workflow is to review the clinical, technology, and home-support requirements together with cardiology nursing, clinical informatics, and social work before we finalize any plan. I'll be making the final enrollment and configuration decision, but I want to make sure we cover all the bases first. Could we start by having cardiology nursing walk us through Mr. Lewis's clinical needs and whether the connected scale and blood-pressure monitoring would be appropriate for his situation?
